impact.text: This allows any random address to withdraw owner assets without permission from the owner.

precondition_sources.text: The caller is an address other than the owner of the shares.
The caller has no allowance authorized by the owner for the shares.

intent_sources.text: For withdraw and redeem, msg.sender must be the owner OR have allowance for the shares.
An address without permission from the owner must not be able to withdraw the owner's assets.
